name: ct_cardiac
description: Order a cardiac CT for coronary artery calcium scoring, CT coronary angiography, or cardiac structural evaluation. Used in chest pain workup and pre-procedural planning.

region.description: Body region to image — focused on the heart

contrast.description: Contrast requirement — non-contrast for calcium scoring, contrast for coronary CTA

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., chest pain risk stratification, pre-TAVR planning)

when_to_use: intermediate-risk chest pain for coronary artery disease risk stratification
coronary CTA as alternative to invasive coronary angiography
pre-TAVR or pre-MitralClip evaluation of cardiac structures and access
anomalous coronary artery evaluation in young patients with chest pain
cardiac mass or pericardial disease characterization

examples.query: 55-year-old male with atypical chest pain, intermediate pretest probability

args.clinical_indication: chest pain, rule out coronary artery disease
